passages.match_topic: Court regulation of private luxury and banquets
passages.selection_note: Parallel claims about expense and pleasure in the second item of 賀琛’s memorial. This is a directly attributed document preserved in the punctuated 1973 Zhonghua Shuju edition of Liang shu.

passages.match_topic: Court regulation of private luxury and banquets
passages.selection_note: The dated context is the same exchange as the memorial. The emperor asks how inspectors could enforce restrictions in private houses. This is a directly attributed document preserved in the punctuated 1973 Zhonghua Shuju edition of Liang shu.

passages.match_topic: Selection of earlier authorities in Tang editorial prefaces
passages.selection_note: The preface describes supplementing one commentator with a second and compressing the resulting text in corresponding four-character clauses. The Wikisource witness is identified as Quan Tang wen, volume 146.

passages.match_topic: Selection of earlier authorities in Tang editorial prefaces
passages.selection_note: A biographical identification note weighs conflicting statements in two prior commentaries and explains which name is kept. This is the main continuous text in the pinned Han shu commentary witness.
